items.title: Signed integral anticyclotomic Euler-system classes from trito-non-ordinary diagonal cycles
items.author: Raúl Alonso; Kâzım Büyükboduk; Antonio Cauchi; Antonio Lei
items.difficulty_reason: The signed integral Euler-system construction combines diagonal cycles on towers of Shimura threefolds, ordinary/nonordinary Hecke projections, three-term vertical norms, anticyclotomic ring-class fields, logarithm matrices and compatible integral Iwasawa-cohomology decomposition, then proves the horizontal Euler-factor relation. Complete author H0 condition, weight-two eigenforms, tame and splitting restrictions retained; this is independent of the prior single specialization relation.

primary.label: complete original Theorem C signed integral classes with matrix decomposition and horizontal Euler relation

proof_spans.label: full author diagonal-family and anticyclotomic construction, horizontal/vertical relations, integral signed decomposition proofs and supporting tower/p-adic L-function appendices

contexts.label: complete original diagonal-cycle, ordinary/nonordinary forms, coefficient and H0 hypotheses and norm-relation context
original main-conjecture and p-adic L-function context/notation retained without extra counts
